scope: R6 schematic implementation; PCB placement/routing reviewed separately

changes.LS120: MLT-5020 C94598, custom 3-pad footprint from maker drawing; pad 1 positive, 2 negative, 3 isolated mechanical tab; 4 kHz, 50% PWM
changes.J121: Black C430601, identical geometry to former orange part; distinct ARM/IGN board legends required
changes.R165: 470k 1% C23178 0603; same electrical value, higher package ratings
changes.feedback: R190 and R206 each 300k 1% C23024 in parallel; 150k equivalent over R191 30k 1%
changes.decoupling: All former C1525 100nF 16V X7R 10% 0402 changed to C307331 100nF 50V X7R 10% 0402

calculations.input_current_assumptions: 6.0 V protected input, 4.93 V output, assumed 85% conversion efficiency; includes neither wiring drop nor startup inrush

limits: HGLRC M100 MINI product specification gives 3.3-5 V input and no maximum current. 4.8 V branch target leaves DC tolerance margin below 5 V; startup and load-transient overshoot need bench measurement.
EBYTE 2026 manual specifies 2.6-5.5 V input and >=3.3 V for rated 22 dBm output, instantaneous TX current range 100-140 mA. Older product webpage differs; use current maker manual.
J131 pin 1=power, 2=GND, 3=GPS TX, 4=GPS RX. Stock HGLRC cable cavity orientation is unverified. Use a verified custom harness; do not assume supplied lead is plug compatible.
CAD/ERC cannot qualify thermal rise, shock/vibration, RF performance, or actual power transient behavior.
